# spacelab-fa

Fundamental astronomy: time scales, Earth rotation, reference frames.

Part of [spacelab](https://github.com/SpaceDataLab/spacelab), astrodynamics in Rust organised around independent
verification: every published number is checked against a lineage that did not come
from the project. This crate is verified in [§1 Time, Earth orientation & geodesy](https://github.com/SpaceDataLab/spacelab/blob/main/docs/verification.md#1--time-earth-orientation--geodesy) (12 rows).

- API documentation: <https://docs.rs/spacelab-fa>
- Homepage: <https://spacedatalab.org>
